$comment: applies this file to the repo on every push to main that changes it.
Keep the type:* and p0-p3 names as they are: pr-labelled, the issue forms and
the release notes rely on them. Add this project's own area:* labels freely.

labels.name: type:feature
labels.description: New capability: the product can now do something it never offered.

labels.name: type:bug
labels.description: Existing behavior is wrong. Still a bug when the repair adds new code or new UI.

labels.name: type:chore
labels.description: No user-visible change: refactors, tests, CI, deps. Counted in the notes, not listed.

labels.name: type:docs
labels.description: Documentation only. Counted in the release notes, not listed.

labels.name: area:chapters
labels.description: The chapter list, hero, panels and the manifest that feeds them.

labels.name: area:engine
labels.description: Prism detection, launch, and the settings that point at it.

labels.name: area:packs
labels.description: Pack sync, packwiz, mrpack import.

labels.name: area:server
labels.description: Server status and joining.

labels.name: area:tokens
labels.description: design/tokens.json and everything generated from it.

labels.name: area:build
labels.description: Build, CI, release, dependencies.

labels.name: area:agents
labels.description: agent_docs, .claude, suite-kit configuration.

labels.name: p0
labels.description: Drop everything.

labels.name: p1
labels.description: High priority, next up.

labels.name: p2
labels.description: Medium priority, normal queue.

labels.name: p3
labels.description: Low priority, nice to have.

labels.name: blocked
labels.description: Cannot proceed until a stated dependency clears.

labels.name: changelog:skip
labels.description: Leave this pull request out of the release notes entirely.

labels.name: status:needs-triage
labels.description: Just filed. Nobody has read it yet.

labels.name: status:needs-info
labels.description: Waiting on the reporter.

labels.name: status:confirmed
labels.description: Reproduced, or accepted as in scope.

labels.name: question
labels.description: Further information is requested.
